scripts.build: npm run build:cloud && npm run build:compres && npm run build:document && npm run build:module
scripts.dev: npm run build:dev && npm run copy:base
scripts.prod: npm run clean:prod && npm run lint && npm run build:prod && npm run verify:publish
scripts.build:cloud:dev: npm run build:cloud && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy:base
scripts.build:compress:dev: npm run build:compress && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy:base
scripts.build:db:dev: npm run build:db && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy:base
scripts.build:document:dev: npm run build:document && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy:base
scripts.build:module:dev: npm run build:module && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy:base
scripts.build:prod: tsc -p ./src/cloud/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./src/compress/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./src/db/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./src/document/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./src/module/tsconfig.json && npm run bundle:prod
scripts.publish:dev: npm run publish:dev:cloud && npm run publish:dev:document
scripts.publish:prod: npm run publish:prod:cloud && npm run publish:prod:document
scripts.publish:dev:cloud: cd publish/ibm && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../minio && npm publish --dry-run
scripts.publish:prod:cloud: cd publish/ibm && npm publish && cd ../minio && npm publish
scripts.publish:dev:document: cd publish/clean-css && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../csso && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../html-minifier && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../html-minifier-terser && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../svgo && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../uglify-js && npm publish --dry-run
scripts.publish:prod:document: cd publish/clean-css && npm publish && cd ../csso && npm publish && cd ../html-minifier && npm publish && cd ../svgo && npm publish && cd ../uglify-js && npm publish
scripts.publish:dev:pi-r: cd publish/jimp && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../redis && npm publish --dry-run && cd ../imagemin && npm publish --dry-run
scripts.publish:prod:pi-r: cd publish/jimp && npm publish && cd ../redis && npm publish && cd ../imagemin && npm publish
scripts.copy:types: npx admin copy -s -i "**/*.d.ts" -m ./src/cloud ./publish && npx admin copy -s -i "**/*.d.ts" -m ./src/db ./publish && npx admin copy -s -i "**/*.d.ts" -m ./src/module ./publish
scripts.bundle:dev: npx admin strip -s -f index -f client -S "@pi-r2/" ./publish ./src/cloud ./build && npx admin strip -s -f index -S "@pi-r/" ./publish ./src/compress ./build && npx admin strip -s -f index -f client -S "@pi-r/" ./publish ./src/db ./build && npx admin strip -s -f index -S "@pi-r2/" ./publish ./src/document ./build && npx admin strip -s -f index -S "@pi-r/" ./publish ./src/module ./build && npm run bundle:exports && npm run copy:types
scripts.bundle:dev:check: npx admin strip -s -f index -f client -S "@pi-r2/" -c ./scripts/checksum.cloud.csv ./publish ./src/cloud ./build && npx admin strip -s -f index -S "@pi-r/" -c ./scripts/checksum.compress.csv ./publish ./src/compress ./build && npx admin strip -s -f index -f client -S "@pi-r/" -c ./scripts/checksum.db.csv ./publish ./src/db ./build && npx admin strip -s -f index -S "@pi-r2/" -c ./scripts/checksum.document.csv ./publish ./src/document ./build && npx admin strip -s -f index -S "@pi-r/" -c ./scripts/checksum.module.csv ./publish ./src/module ./build && npm run bundle:exports && npm run copy:types
scripts.bundle:prod: npx admin strip -f index -S "@pi-r2/" -c ./scripts/checksum.cloud.csv ./publish ./src/cloud ./build && npx admin strip -f index -S "@pi-r/" -c ./scripts/checksum.compress.csv ./publish ./src/compress ./build && npx admin strip -f index -S "@pi-r/" -c ./scripts/checksum.db.csv ./publish ./src/db ./build && npx admin strip -f index -S "@pi-r2/" -c ./scripts/checksum.document.csv ./publish ./src/document ./build && npx admin strip -f index -S "@pi-r/" -c ./scripts/checksum.module.csv ./publish ./src/module ./build && npm run bundle:exports && npm run copy:types
scripts.clean:prod: npm run clean && npx admin remove -E js -s publish
